Title: PROTOCOL 1.0 – Mathematical Root Axiom for Deterministic Clean Networking (MCP 1.0)

Abstract:
PROTOCOL 1.0 defines a minimal, mathematically clean root axiom for digital networks. 
It establishes a single, immutable starting point (1.0) that guarantees deterministic behavior, zero-noise signal integrity, and immediate elimination of entropy.
